gpr_comparator.interpretation: GPR is a comparator for broad risk, never a physical-closure proxy

external_eia_flow_validation.use: external quarterly validation only; not expanded into daily rows

insurance_cost_measure.reason: No auditable daily war-risk premium series was available; the analysis omits it rather than fabricating or interpolating values.

shipping_status_validation.source_org: Joint Maritime Information Center via IMO
shipping_status_validation.interpretation: independent status observation only; not treated as an exact reopening timestamp

limitations: One conflict episode: estimates are associative, not structurally causal.
AIS jamming, spoofing and dark vessels can bias PortWatch traffic counts.
Gas-likely marginal hours are a transparent proxy, not plant-level bid-stack proof.
